name: Invert the axis
operator: vertical becomes horizontal or time runs backwards
example: a timeline that starts in the present and scrolls into the past

name: Abuse the scale
operator: one element 10x bigger or smaller than expected
example: a footer wordmark three screens wide

name: Swap the material
operator: paper becomes glass; a list becomes a map
example: a price list printed as a receipt

name: Remove the expected
operator: no nav, no hero image or no grid
example: a hotel site with no photos until the rooms

name: Make the UI the content
operator: the scrollbar is the timeline; the cursor is the product
example: a torch-cursor that is the lamp being sold

name: Shift the tempo
operator: one section moves at film speed while others stay still
example: a frozen page with one chapter in slow motion

name: Borrow a print rule
operator: marginalia, footnotes, folios or a colophon

name: Reverse the reveal
operator: start complete and take away as you scroll
example: a cluttered desk that tidies as you read

name: Single object
operator: the whole site orbits one object
example: a ceramic cup that rotates through every section

name: Wrong room
example: a SaaS homepage built as a restaurant menu

name: Second person
operator: the visitor becomes a character in the layout
example: your name or local time set in the hero

name: Self-imposed constraint
operator: one colour, one size or one font weight only
example: a portfolio set entirely in one size of type
